sentences.text: Winnicavis is an extinct genus classified within the passerine birds, a large order known as Passeriformes.
Scientists have recorded only a single fossil occurrence of this unique bird in the global database.
Bocheński and colleagues described the genus in 2018 after finding fossils in Poland. The type species is named Winnicavis gorskii.
This animal lived during the Early Oligocene epoch, specifically between 33.9 and 27.3 million years ago in the Rupelian stage.
